column1: # tests/ci/cloud_kinds.tsv -- the DECLARED kinds of a cloud run ([CLOUD-SUITE] B, requirement 7). ONE table, read by
# the workflow's plan job, scripts/cloudrun and tests/ci/cloud_gather.sh through tests/ci/cloud_kinds.sh; no
# code names a kind (tests/ci/cloud_check.sh holds that). A new kind is a new row.
#   kind        the KIND in the branch cloud/OWNER/KIND/NAME
#   command     what one shard runs; {shard} = K/N, {selector} = the selector column
#   selector    what picks a shard's work (for test: the declared shard table; `-` = none)
#   shards      N, or `table` = the `# shards=N` line of the selector file
#   max_parallel  shards that run at once (a shard count above it queues in waves)
#   limit_min   per-shard step limit in minutes (a shard past it is RED by name, never green)
#   needs       setup the shard needs: `pcre2` = the pinned libpcre2 10.46 build; `-` = none. shard-setup provides exactly this set today
#               (cloud_check.sh refuses a value it cannot provide)
#   owners      who may start it: `*` = any owner, else a comma list
